scenarios.name: The Shutter Court
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 broken ring: the crowned breach and the shutter court
scenarios.purpose: A 2048 px scrolling hall (R0 and R1 of the Broken Ring, KR1). One continuous ground lane. Platform 0 is the 64 px step (a 16 px rise onto the walkway, KR2), platform 1 the 80 px stone walkway over the arch (top 80, underside 68: the CF02-Q45 slab), platform 2 the 128 px Donut-only shelf on the goblins' side, 224 px clear of the walkway (KR8). The shutter that fills the arch under the walkway is an encounter sidecar prop, not room geometry.
scenarios.expected: Spawns, the shutter, zones and the roster come from f01_ring_court.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The ceiling is the DP-Q45 soffit at 228 px above the walking line (KR9).
scenarios.coop: Solo with a swap, or two players: the walkway crossing over the shutter is reachable by Carl's 80 px class from the 64 px step; the 128 px shelf is optional and boosted-Donut only.
